recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR-33388. If the work group wants a generic Task.focus search parameter, a different focus-canonical search type, or a no-mixed-reference/canonical invariant, resolve FHIR-51913 or a follow-up OO/FHIR-I issue first.
issue_request: FHIR-33388 was an Applied OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking for Task.focus to support canonical targets in addition to references, with related restriction-constraint, search-parameter, and example updates.
initial_application: HL7/fhir PR #3879, merged as 44595732b09b, changed Task.focus from a direct Reference element to a repeating BackboneElement with value[x] Reference or canonical, updated tsk-1 to require a reference-valued focus when restriction is present, split focus search into focus-reference and focus-canonical, updated the Patient compartment row to focus-reference, and revised examples to use valueReference/valueCanonical.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected Task StructureDefinition, search-parameter bundle, examples, and compartments spreadsheet are in build scope. OO minutes from 2025-10-03 record the 6-0-1 motion matching the Jira disposition. The implementers Zulip thread and submitted FHIR-51913 show that broader canonical search-parameter behavior remains unresolved FHIR-I clarification context, not a final decision to alter FHIR-33388 here.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source already allows Task.focus.value[x] to be Reference(Any) or canonical(CanonicalResource), has tsk-1 testing focus.value.ofType(Reference), defines focus-reference and focus-canonical search parameters, maps the Patient compartment to focus-reference, and includes canonical focus examples.
